info.title: Pending Spotify Context recovery text
info.description: PENDING source contract for the existing failed request.error string, not an HTTP/MCP operation error envelope. No new endpoint, action, field, state or RPC. Matching API release and current Docs acceptance are required.

ContextIngestFailureText.description: Authored code and guidance persisted through the existing claim-token-guarded failure RPC. Historical errors may retain the earlier generic string; this pending component does not tighten the existing read response schema.

oneOf.const: unsupported_input: Track ingestion requires a single Spotify track URL. Use ingest_release for an album locator; playlists and artist pages are not track inputs. YouTube ingestion is not enabled.
oneOf.title: unsupported_input

oneOf.const: recording_unavailable: Spotify did not return this track for this request. Check the URL and availability before deciding whether to retry or submit a different track as a new request.
oneOf.title: recording_unavailable

oneOf.const: provider_outage: The Spotify metadata request was interrupted, unavailable or rate limited. Check saved state and wait for recovery before an authorized retry with unchanged input and the same idempotency key.
oneOf.title: provider_outage

oneOf.const: provider_rejected: Spotify rejected the metadata request. Check provider access configuration and saved state before deciding whether to retry with unchanged input and the same idempotency key.
oneOf.title: provider_rejected

oneOf.const: provider_response_invalid: The Spotify response could not be validated as the requested recording metadata. Review the source and saved state before retrying; do not infer an accepted identity from this failure.
oneOf.title: provider_response_invalid

oneOf.const: identity_conflict: The returned recording or saved identity disagrees with this request. Review the conflict and saved state before retrying; do not substitute a relinked recording or guess artist identity.
oneOf.title: identity_conflict

oneOf.const: unknown: The extraction outcome could not be classified. Check saved state and current workspace access before deciding whether to retry. An error does not establish whether a commit completed; do not automatically resubmit with a new key.
oneOf.title: unknown
